title: Toward negotiable reinforcement learning: shifting priorities in Pareto optimal sequential decision-making
reasoning: The paper is focused on AI alignment and social choice theory, specifically how to negotiate between conflicting values (utilities) and beliefs of different parties. It evaluates the adequacy of utilitarian frameworks (Harsanyi's theorem) and explores the concept of 'moral realism' through a formal mathematical lens, using a cake-splitting dilemma to illustrate its findings.
